reference_sql:
WITH feb AS (SELECT ol.product_id, SUM(ol.quantity) AS units FROM order_lines ol JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = ol.order_id JOIN stores s ON s.store_id = o.store_id WHERE s.store_code = 'NL-01' AND o.order_ts >= TIMESTAMP '2025-02-01' AND o.order_ts < TIMESTAMP '2025-03-01' GROUP BY ol.product_id),
mar AS (SELECT ol.product_id, SUM(ol.quantity) AS units FROM order_lines ol JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = ol.order_id JOIN stores s ON s.store_id = o.store_id WHERE s.store_code = 'NL-01' AND o.order_ts >= TIMESTAMP '2025-03-01' AND o.order_ts < TIMESTAMP '2025-04-01' GROUP BY ol.product_id)
SELECT COALESCE(f.product_id, m.product_id) AS product_id, COALESCE(f.units, 0) AS feb_units, COALESCE(m.units, 0) AS mar_units
FROM feb f
FULL OUTER JOIN mar m ON m.product_id = f.product_id
alternatives: SELECT ol.product_id, COALESCE(SUM(ol.quantity) FILTER (WHERE o.order_ts < TIMESTAMP '2025-03-01'), 0) AS feb_units, COALESCE(SUM(ol.quantity) FILTER (WHERE o.order_ts >= TIMESTAMP '2025-03-01'), 0) AS mar_units FROM order_lines ol JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = ol.order_id JOIN stores s ON s.store_id = o.store_id WHERE s.store_code = 'NL-01' AND o.order_ts >= TIMESTAMP '2025-02-01' AND o.order_ts < TIMESTAMP '2025-04-01' GROUP BY ol.product_id
